scenarios.title: A｜试探询问
scenarios.setting: 对象之前说周五晚上一直在家，但玩家无意中得知对方其实出去见了朋友。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: What did you end up doing Friday night?

feedback.naturalExpression: What did you end up doing Friday night?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: So, did you just stay home all Friday?

feedback.naturalExpression: So, did you just stay home all Friday?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You said you were home Friday night, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: You said you were home Friday night, right?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Did you happen to go out at all on Friday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you happen to go out at all on Friday?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: No, I don’t think so. I was home most of the night.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Most of the night? Did you go somewhere earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: Most of the night? Did you go somewhere earlier?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Are you sure? I heard you were out that evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you sure? I heard you were out that evening.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s strange. Sam said he saw you downtown.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s strange. Sam said he saw you downtown.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m asking because what I heard doesn’t match what you told me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m asking because what I heard doesn’t match what you told me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Oh. I did go out for a little while. I forgot about that.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: You forgot that you went out?

feedback.naturalExpression: You forgot that you went out?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay… so who were you with?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay… so who were you with?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Why didn’t you mention that when I asked you before?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why didn’t you mention that when I asked you before?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m a little confused because your story keeps changing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m a little confused because your story keeps changing.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜直接质问
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经确认对方之前说的事情不是真的。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know you weren’t home Friday night. Why did you lie to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you weren’t home Friday night. Why did you lie to me?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need you to be honest with me. You weren’t where you said you were.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to be honest with me. You weren’t where you said you were.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I found out you went out Friday night, even though you told me you stayed home.

feedback.naturalExpression: I found out you went out Friday night, even though you told me you stayed home.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I know what you told me wasn’t true. I want to understand why.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know what you told me wasn’t true. I want to understand why.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Why did you cheat me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you weren’t home Friday night. Why did you lie to me?
feedback.explanation: cheat 通常不是“对我撒谎”；这里说 lie to me

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That’s not really the point. I’m asking why you lied.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s not really the point. I’m asking why you lied.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: It doesn’t matter who told me. Is it true?

feedback.naturalExpression: It doesn’t matter who told me. Is it true?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We can talk about that later. Right now, I want an honest answer.

feedback.naturalExpression: We can talk about that later. Right now, I want an honest answer.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Please don’t turn this into a conversation about how I found out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please don’t turn this into a conversation about how I found out.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I didn’t want you to get upset.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: So you decided lying to me was better?

feedback.naturalExpression: So you decided lying to me was better?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I might have been upset, but I’d rather hear the truth.

feedback.naturalExpression: I might have been upset, but I’d rather hear the truth.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Hiding it makes this much harder for me to trust you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hiding it makes this much harder for me to trust you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You don’t get to decide what I can handle by lying to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t get to decide what I can handle by lying to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜对方承认
scenarios.setting: 在“发现对象撒谎”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方承认”。

turns.text: Okay. I lied. I knew you’d be upset if I told you where I was going.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Thank you for finally being honest with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for finally being honest with me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I appreciate you admitting it, but I’m still really hurt.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate you admitting it, but I’m still really hurt.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What I need to understand now is why you felt you had to hide it.

feedback.naturalExpression: What I need to understand now is why you felt you had to hide it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: The fact that you lied worries me more than where you actually went.

feedback.naturalExpression: The fact that you lied worries me more than where you actually went.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I was scared we’d have another argument.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Avoiding an argument by lying just creates a bigger problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: Avoiding an argument by lying just creates a bigger problem.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand you were worried, but we need to be able to tell each other the truth.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand you were worried, but we need to be able to tell each other the truth.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If something is difficult to tell me, I’d rather we talk about it than hide it.

feedback.naturalExpression: If something is difficult to tell me, I’d rather we talk about it than hide it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I need some time to think about whether I can trust you after this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need some time to think about whether I can trust you after this.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I appreciate the apology, but rebuilding trust is going to take time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology, but rebuilding trust is going to take time.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I need some time to process this.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I need some time to process this.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I want to work through this, but I need honesty from now on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to work through this, but I need honesty from now on.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
